name: manual_1a984f
claim: Fable-5 MCP Diagnostics: Implement single-command health probe across all registered MCP servers (CRG, gbrain, alphaclaw-mcp, ai-cli-mcp) with <10s response time. Catches tool degradation within 1 invocation before cascade. Detects stale-name failures (detect_changes vs detect_changes_tool) and down-server escalation. Consensus: 6/7 subagent types. Emit OTEL span in router trace stream. Foundation: orchestrator/mcp_diagnostics.py mirrors connectivity.py endpoint_online() cache (one source of truth).

decisions.notes: ADR-045 error-resilience Phase 1-3 complete; mcp_diagnostics.py needed to bridge observability gap. Currently ad hoc per-tool checks scattered across docs/local-env-catch-up.md. Single canonical probe prevents redundant offline probes, improves cache hit rate, unifies timeout semantics (LINT-301/LINT-401 enforcement: 100% of MCP calls wrapped with 10s timeout).
